To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

SiC nanowhiskers can be grown directly from silicon substrates, and that the growth of SiC whiskers is followed by the growth of a C layer on the whisker surface, which results in coaxial SiC-C nanocables.
SiC-C coaxical nanocables were successfully synthesized via the direct synthesis of SiC nanorods and subsequent carbon deposition.
the thickness of the carbon layer in coaxial SiC-C nanocables can be tuned in the range 1-50 nm by varying the growth conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of SiC-C core-shell nanocables with controllable C outer layer thicknesses.
the fabrication of SiC-C nanocables and the study of the effect of carbon thickness on their structural and electrical properties.
the synthesis of coaxial nanocable structures with a variety of materials combinations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thickness of the graphitic outer shells of the coaxial SiC-C nanocables can be controlled and the degree of crystallinity of the graphitic shells increases with the shell thickness.
the SiC-C coaxal nanocables are a promising material for the fabrication of nanoelectromechanical systems (NEMS).
the thickness of the graphitic layers is controlled by the growth conditions, i.e. the pyrolysis temperature and the methane concentration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SiC-C coaxical nanocable is a new kind of one dimensional nanostructure, which can be used for the fabrication of nano-electrode and nano-electronic devices.
the thickness of the outer C layers of SiC-C core-shell coaxial nanowires can be controlled in a large range, from 2 nm to 50 nm.
the thickness of the graphitic outer layers can be controlled in the range of 1-50 nm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thickness of C outer layers of SiC-C nanocables can be controlled in a wide range by adjusting the pyrolysis conditions.
the C outer layers of SiC-C nanocables can be controlled by the growth conditions.
it is possible to grow aligned coaxial SiC-C nanocables with a controlled thickness of the C layers.
